rationale: Retain USD Clean Fuels as an active Ara Partners infrastructure portfolio company while correcting its canonical legal identity and the timing and terms of Ara's investment. Ara's current portfolio identifies USD Clean Fuels as an active Infrastructure Fund I investment made in December 2023, and Ara's January 2, 2024 announcement confirms that it had acquired a majority interest. The exact percentage and any minority holders are not publicly disclosed. Current official company and manager sources support the Houston headquarters, 2021 formation, renewable-fuels terminal and logistics business, and continued active ownership; no subsequent exit or pending transfer was found through August 12, 2026.

companyFieldUpdates.name: USD Clean Fuels, LLC
companyFieldUpdates.description: USD Clean Fuels, LLC is a Houston-based developer, owner and operator of multimodal terminal and logistics infrastructure for renewable diesel, biodiesel, sustainable aviation fuel, ethanol and related feedstocks. The platform serves North American clean-fuels producers and distributors through rail-connected terminal, storage, transloading and last-mile logistics assets, including its California terminal network. Ara Partners acquired a majority interest through Ara Infrastructure Fund I in December 2023; the exact percentage and any minority holders are not publicly disclosed.
